structural-causal.name: bottleneckControl
structural-causal.basis: Photonics exposure addresses a scaling bottleneck as AI clusters require higher-bandwidth interconnects.

structural-causal.name: scenarioRobustness
structural-causal.basis: Optical intensity can rise under several AI scaling paths, but copper persistence, architecture changes or share loss weaken company capture.

structural-causal.name: substitutionResilience
structural-causal.basis: Optics has structural bandwidth advantages at scale, while alternate optical suppliers and architecture choices remain substitutes.

discovery-weak-signals.name: Optical bottleneck exposure
discovery-weak-signals.basis: AI datacenter optical transition and expanding production capacity align with Coherent's photonics portfolio.

adversarial-red-team.name: thesisQuality
adversarial-red-team.basis: Structural optical demand is plausible and operating execution is strong, but share/content and concentration are not quantified.

adversarial-red-team.name: pricingPower
adversarial-red-team.basis: Margin expansion alone does not prove durable component-level pricing power.

expectations-execution.name: Execution quality
expectations-execution.basis: Revenue growth coincided with margin expansion and faster EPS growth.
